prompt:
Create ONE four-frame WALK CYCLE sprite sheet for Xixifu NORMAL costume in attached image1. Strictly preserve that character's face, skull size, body/limb proportions, staff shape/length and all clothing. Image2 is approved identity turnaround supporting reference, not an extra character. Facing LEFT in every frame, same mild top-down viewpoint as image1, moving left. Transparent background, exactly2columns x2rows with equal independent cells, large margins inside each cell, no frames touching cell boundaries. 2048x2048 if possible. Exactly4 complete bodies, reading order top-left,top-right,bottom-left,bottom-right. No text or grid lines, no shadow or detached effects.

AUTHORED WALK PHASES:
1 left leg steps forward(left), right leg stretches behind(right); BOTH distinct boots visible, heel-forward/contact.
2 the rear right boot PASSES UNDER THE CENTER OF THE HIPS, beside planted supporting leg; feet almost meet horizontally, passing knee bends slightly and heel lifted, no straddle.
3 right leg now forward(left), left leg behind(right), opposite contact to frame1, distinct correct foreground/back overlaps.
4 left boot PASSES UNDER HIPS CENTER beside supporting leg, opposite passing of frame2, toes/heel distinct.
Full-body forward-walking gait, not sliding robes or only moving sleeve. Robe mid-calf hem reveals actual leggings/boots and the small bent knee where visible. Hand carries staff steadily anatomical RIGHT hand; free arm makes small natural alternating swing. Upperbody/head stays upright and same absolute scale with virtually no sideways sway or head rotation between frames. Staff tilt/body hair only mild natural follow-through, no glowingmagic; long hair rests close to back, not blown sideways. Never add boots/high heels or swap staffhand.

Compact approved normal Xixifu: near-black long hair, black eyes, lowered hood behind hair not cutting across it, charcoal midcalf robe/lavender lining/silverbutterflyclasp/clothwaisttie/darkleggings/blackshortboots. Smooth NON-PIXEL hand-drawn outline, broad2-3tone painted/cel forms. Crisp transparentalpha, no background. SAME HEAD AND BODY SIZE in all4, crowns and planted foot ground line aligned within each cell. Exactly4frames, not more, no extra view or pose.
